strongest_argument: The claim's load-bearing premise - that the cohort table exists only in the transcript of a nano-cap ADR call - is factually wrong, verified by fetching the source. Every figure cited is in So-Young's own PR Newswire release of 2026-05-22 and therefore the 6-K: 41 centres profitable, 48 with positive quarterly operating cash flow, plus the full cohort table (11 ramp-up at RMB2.1m, 23 growth at RMB4.8m, 20 mature at RMB7.5m per centre per quarter). It also travelled: guancha.cn and ITBear reproduced the per-stage table verbatim in Chinese, and the transcript was syndicated by Motley Fool, Benzinga, Globe and Mail, Yahoo and AOL. Worse for the claim, the RMB307-317m Q2 guidance sits in that same release and is management's own forecast built off that same cohort plus the 59 centres open at report date - so 'cohort maturation covers most of guidance' is not a discovery, it is the assertion that the company will hit its published guidance, which is the consensus anchor for this print by definition. The market already adjudicated this trade-off once: on 2026-05-22 it had both the store-level profitability data and the widening loss in front of it and chose the loss, taking the stock down ~12% pre-market. Finally the mechanism does not reach the consolidated line: 41 of 54 stores were profitable in the very quarter attributable net loss widened to RMB49.2m from RMB33.1m while the high-margin legacy information-services segment fell 34.0% to RMB80.3m.

prior_publication.what_it_says: Company press release states 41 centres profitable and 48 OCF-positive, contains the full cohort table, and gives the RMB307.0-317.0m Q2 2026 guidance the claim says it implies.
Chinese business press reproducing the 41/48 counts and the full per-store revenue-by-maturity-stage breakdown.
Chinese trade write-up detailing the three-stage cohort split with per-centre quarterly revenue.
Shares fell ~12% pre-market on the widening loss despite the revenue beat: the market saw the store-profitability disclosure and discounted it.
Full transcript republished on a major US retail financial site, contradicting the claim that the call content had no distribution.

baseline_evidence: Two price events cover this. The information's own publication date, 2026-05-22, produced a ~12% pre-market decline in which the market weighed store-level profitability against the widening consolidated loss and chose the loss. And the run-in: +30.43% over 20 days into 2026-08-28 at spot 2.40, +81.8% off the 52-week low on a 171,890-share ADV nano-cap - the market has already re-rated the clinic-ramp story ahead of the print. Options show no residual asymmetry: put/call OI 0.11 on 200 contracts, no computable 25d skew, so there is no downside bid this finding would surprise; positioning if anything already leans to the bull case.
materiality: material to the aesthetic treatment revenue line but immaterial as information, because that line is the published guidance itself; and immaterial to the consolidated result the market reacts to, since 41-of-54 store profitability coexisted with net loss widening to RMB49.2m from RMB33.1m and information services falling 34.0% to RMB80.3m
what_would_change_my_verdict: Evidence that the Q2 cohort disclosure will show maturation materially ahead of the published table in a way that flips the consolidated loss trajectory, not just revenue in line with guidance management already printed on 2026-05-22.
